en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural village in a mountainous landscape. In the middle distance stands a church with a tall clock tower topped by an onion-shaped dome, surrounded by clustered village houses and terraced hills. In the foreground, a woman in traditional dress is seated in a field working, while another figure walks along a dirt path leading livestock. The scene is framed by hills rising in the background. At the bottom center of the card, beneath the image, is the printed caption.
